footer.note: FootSim creates statistical simulations for entertainment and analysis. It is not betting advice.
player.positionHint.Goalkeeper: Only goalkeepers are shown. The radar covers saves, goals conceded and build-up play.
player.positionHint.Defender: Only defenders are shown. The radar covers duels, interceptions and passing.
player.positionHint.Midfielder: Only midfielders are shown. The radar covers passing, creativity and defensive work.
player.positionHint.Attacker: Only forwards and wingers are shown. The radar covers finishing, assists and dribbling.
player.positionHint.free: All positions are allowed. Only metrics with the same meaning for every position are compared.
player.resetOnSwitch: Your selection was reset because you chose another position group.
player.scopeHint.club_all: League, domestic cups and European competitions together.
player.scopeHint.league: National league only. The fairest comparison because all players face the same opponents and number of matches.
player.scopeHint.cl: Champions League only. Fewer matches than a league season, but consistently strong opposition.
player.scopeHint.euro: European Championship finals only. A short tournament that should be read as a small sample.
player.scopeHint.world_cup: World Cup finals only. A short tournament that should be read as a small sample.
player.scopeHint.national: Senior international matches only. Few matches per season, so treat this as a small sample.
player.scopeHint.all: Club and senior international matches together. This mixes very different competition levels.
player.scopeHint.big_games: Big Games are competitive matches against strong opponents: UEFA top-30 clubs or FIFA top-20 national teams. Important knockout matches also count. Friendlies do not count.
